lesson_intro.heading: CSA L1 · CloudWatch dashboards
lesson_intro.board_text:
Dashboards and Metrics
Finova monitoring for support

• Namespace + metric name
• Statistic and period
• Read a spike before you reboot
• Add a widget for the ticket service
lesson_intro.ren_voice: Monitoring is half of L1. Before you restart anything, you read the graph. Today — dashboards, metrics, how to see a CPU spike and not panic.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Metric basics
• Namespace: AWS/EC2, AWS/S3, …
• Metric: CPUUtilization, StatusCheckFailed
• Statistic: Average, Maximum
• Period: 1 minute vs 5 minutes

Support habit: confirm region, then open the dashboard for that service.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: A metric is a named time series in a namespace. Statistic and period change what the line means. Wrong region — empty dashboard. Same lesson as day one.

segments.title: Open dashboards
segments.setup_voice: CloudWatch Dashboards — Finova keeps one per environment.

steps.voice: All metrics view is where you hunt a metric that is not on a dashboard yet.

segments.lesson_voice: Tickets often say the site is slow. You open the EC2 CPU widget before you SSH. Graphs first.

check.voice: Why check region before trusting an empty CloudWatch dashboard?
check.response_if_correct: CloudWatch metrics are regional. Wrong region looks like nothing is wrong — or nothing exists.
check.response_if_incorrect: Same trap as missing EC2 — which control changes your entire view?

steps.voice: Pick EC2 CPUUtilization — Average over 5 minutes is the usual L1 read.
Add widget puts it on the dashboard so the next ticket is faster.
Read the line: a spike to 90% for one period is different from sustained 90%.

check.voice: Maximum vs Average — which catches a short CPU spike better?
check.response_if_correct: Maximum — Average can hide a short spike inside the period.
check.response_if_incorrect: Think about a one-minute spike inside a five-minute average.

segments.title: Open Dashboards
segments.completion_voice: Good. That is your first stop on a performance ticket.

segments.title: Synthesis
segments.question: Ticket: checkout API latency high. What do you open first in CloudWatch and what two metric settings do you verify?
segments.response_if_correct: Dashboard or metrics for the service — confirm region, then statistic and period so you are not misreading the line.
segments.response_if_incorrect: Graphs before reboot — which console, and which two knobs change the line?

session_close.ren_voice: Namespace, metric, statistic, period, region. Read before you act. Next — alarms so the graph pages you.

doubt_session.ren_response_template: Cover namespace, metric, statistic, period, region, and widgets. Defer custom metrics math and Contributor Insights.
